preToolUse.powershell: $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($input -match '(?i)git\s+push|rm\s+-rf|chmod\s+777|cat\s+.*(\.env|id_rsa|\.npmrc)') { '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Camel Kit safety hook blocked destructive or secret-sensitive shell command."}' }
